aliases.analyst_notes: Trend Micro introduced Earth Berberoka as the same tracked group also named GamblingPuppet.

actor.description: Trend Micro tracks Earth Berberoka (also named GamblingPuppet) as a multiplatform APT group targeting online gambling sites, with additional observed targeting beyond gambling. The vendor reports indicators suggesting Chinese-speaking operators but explicitly stops short of high-confidence origin attribution.
